options: A single EC2 virtual machine
An isolated, Northbridge-controlled network space defined by a CIDR block
A firewall rule for inbound traffic
A storage bucket for product images
questions.explain: A VPC is an isolated network space with its own address range, inside which all of Northbridge's other networked AWS resources live.

options: To delete the VPC after the subnet is created
Terraform requires alphabetical resource ordering
The subnet must exist inside a VPC, and the reference tells Terraform the VPC has to be created first
It has no functional purpose, only documentation value
questions.explain: A subnet always belongs to a VPC. Referencing the VPC's id both wires the subnet into the right VPC and lets Terraform infer that the VPC must be created first.

questions.q: What is required before resources in a subnet can reach the public internet?
options: Nothing extra — any subnet can reach the internet by default
An aws_internet_gateway attached to the VPC, with a route table sending 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to it
A second VPC peered to the first
An IAM role attached to the subnet
questions.explain: A VPC with no internet gateway is sealed off. Attaching a gateway and routing outbound traffic to it through a route table is what makes a subnet public.

options: Which AWS region resources are created in
Inbound and outbound traffic allowed to and from the resources it's attached to
The CIDR block of the VPC
The IAM permissions of the EC2 instance
questions.explain: A security group acts as a stateful firewall, with ingress and egress rules defining exactly what traffic is permitted — nothing is open by default.

questions.q: In the `aws_instance` block for Northbridge's order-processing fleet, what do `subnet_id` and `vpc_security_group_ids` do?
options: They are optional metadata with no effect on provisioning
They wire the EC2 instance into the network and security group defined earlier, letting Terraform infer the dependency order
They specify the IAM role attached to the instance
They configure the instance's operating system
questions.explain: These attributes reference the subnet and security group resources defined earlier in the same configuration, so Terraform knows the instance depends on them and creates them first.
